info.about: Zero Escape: Virtue's Last Reward is a 2012 adventure game developed by Chunsoft. It is the second installment in the Zero Escape series, and was originally released for the Nintendo 3DS and PlayStation Vita.
info.trivia: Aksys published it in 2012 in a run small enough that the Vita version sold out quickly.
info.why: A small Aksys print run; the 2017 Nonary Games collection covers players but not this version.
